To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a simple epidemiological microparsite model can exhibit the extinction dynamics of the host, and the extinction dynamics resembles that exhibited by a ratio-dependent predator-preya model.

a simple deterministic model can be used to explain the parasite induced deterministic extinction phenomena observed in experiments, and that the extinction dynamics is similar to that of ratio-dependent predation models.

a plausible parasite induced host extinction can be explained by the revised parasite-host interaction model, which is a modification of that of Ebert and co-workers, and that a ratio-dependent type model is the simplest model for parasite induced host extinction.

a deterministic model for parasite-host interactions.
the extinction dynamics of a parasite-host model.
